replacements.RouteLLM: enrutar cada query al modelo c: RouteLLM: route each query to the right model
replacements.Un clasificador ligero decide qué nivel: A lightweight classifier decides how much compute each request needs. Simple requests go to fast, inexpensive models; only complex ones activate deep reasoning.
replacements.El router opera antes de que la query ll: The router runs before the query reaches the inference model. It adds minimal latency (~50 ms) but can reduce total cost by 60–80%.
replacements.\"Analiza los fallos de razonamiento en: "Analyze the reasoning failures in this philosophical argument"
replacements.Modelo pequeño (~1B parámetros) que pred: Small model (~1B parameters) that predicts query difficulty. It runs in ~50 ms, far less than the destination model's inference time.
replacements.El clasificador no necesita ser perfecto: The classifier does not need to be perfect — it only needs to be good enough for the cost savings to outweigh classification errors.
replacements.Umbral de enrutamiento — calibrado hacia: Routing threshold — calibrated toward the strong model
replacements.Query simple va al razonador: coste extr: A simple query goes to the reasoning model: extra cost, correct answer
replacements.Query compleja va al rápido: respuesta d: A complex query goes to the fast model: lower-quality answer
replacements.El paper de RouteLLM (2024) reporta redu: The RouteLLM paper (2024) reports an 85% cost reduction while retaining 95% of the strong model's performance on standard benchmarks.
replacements.Sin routing — todo al modelo fuerte: No routing — everything to the strong model
replacements.El routing no es solo una optimización d: Routing is not only an infrastructure optimization — it is a product decision. It means deciding which errors the system is willing to accept and how much additional reliability is worth.
